_comment: Values every R-rung gate and run-to-m9.sh read. Each value carries its provenance; a re-set value names the evidence dir that measured it.

T_ctl_s.provenance: evidence/r0/20261023T065002Z calibration: L_max 12.919 ms over 10 complete trigger steps, T_ctl = max(30 s, ceil(20 x L_max)) = 30 s; host load 1.03 (20 CPUs), VM load 1.29; CPU hold released by the user 15:44 KST

W_s.provenance: start value max(1 s, 3 x p99.9 of L); re-set at R2 and R3 from calibration runs

outage_threshold_minus_1000.provenance: substitution 1 applied: Q2 = 5 LTE outage switches at -5 dB in the R0-config null-control run (evidence/r0/20261023T073520Z q2OutageSwitches 5); reported in the run report

ts_xapp_default_rmr_handler.provenance: substitution 2 applied: the stray-ack probe crashed the TS xApp (glibc double free, exit 139; evidence/p5/20261024T000354Z crashed true); Testbed fork install_patch_files/xApps/ts/src/ts_xapp/ts_xapp.cpp.default_handler.patch; reported in the run report

ts_xapp_a1_payload_string.provenance: substitution 3 (user, 2026-10-24 08:25 KST, plans/reports/decisions-261024-0825-GH-1-substitution-3-a1-payload-ruling.md): the TS xApp also parses the A1 policy body sent as a JSON string; Testbed fork install_patch_files/xApps/ts, applied unconditionally

outageThreshold_dB.provenance: substitution 1: the R0-config null-control run at the default -5 dB counted 5 LTE outage switches (evidence/r0/20261023T073520Z q2OutageSwitches 5; also 065002Z, 065551Z); gated runs use --outageThreshold=-1000

simStartEpochMs.provenance: D10; 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z, the value gate S1 pinned (evidence/s1/20261022T191853Z, runs with --simStartEpochMs)

a1_threshold.provenance: set at P5 from the R2 schedule

r0.provenance: P3: the R0 scenario gated green at evidence/r0/20261023T073520Z

r1.provenance: P4: the R1 scenario (cases (a)-(d) and the faultStop block) gated green at evidence/r1/20261023T084654Z
